releaseTitle: XECEAY v1.1.5 — Synced Karaoke Lyrics, Dynamic Ambient Glow & 3D Spatializer
changelog: Added interactive Synced Karaoke Lyrics with real-time autoscroll & line-seeking, Dynamic Ambient Artwork Glow tinting the player canvas, 3D Surround Spatializer with trending audiophile modes (Slowed + Reverb, Nightcore, 3D Spatial), and smooth sleep timer volume fade-out.
